parsedVerdict.reasoning: The src/application module is a coherent set of use cases for orders and stock. Each use case is a class with an `execute` method that receives domain repository interfaces through its constructor and returns DTOs from order-dto.ts. The module's two helpers are used consistently. Every lookup of one order goes through `requireOrder`, which is the only place the not-found rule lives (advance, cancel and get use it). Every order result goes through `toOrderDto`. Stock rules stay in the domain (`reserveStock` and `releaseStock`), and order-state validation is left to the domain's `isOrderState`. Nothing copies or bypasses these abstractions. There are minor style points, but none fails the rubric: (1) place-order-use-case.ts and cancel-order-use-case.ts both build a product-by-id map with `new Map(found.map(p => [p.id, p]))`, which is a one-line duplication of mapping code, not a duplicated business rule; (2) list-stock-levels-use-case.ts maps products to stock DTOs inline instead of through a shared mapper, but there is only one place that does this mapping; (3) `StockLevelDto` is declared in order-dto.ts, so the file name is a little misleading.
